programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha na Losgannan sa ghàrradh, ach am fàs iad sìthean àlainn fhàs mus till a h-uile duine? The Froglets try gardening, but can they grow a beautiful flower before everyone returns?

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Mamaidh a’ faireachdainn sàraichte is tha i airson ’s gun dèan iad iomlaid len cuid obraichean – gus na tuig iad cho duilich ’s a tha obraichean càch a chèile. Mamaidh is feeling fed up and she wants them all to swap jobs, so they understand how difficult each other’s jobs actually are.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha a’ Chearc Iarainn a’ sealltainn às dèidh na h-oidhcheagan beaga an-diugh ach, mo chreach sa thàinig, abair g’ eil iad ùpraideach! The Iron Chicken is looking after little ones today but, oh my goodness, they are so very noisy!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: AChan fhaigh Oona cadal 's i iomagaineach mu bhith seinn aig briseadh an là son a' chiad turas. Tha Mama ga toirt air turas dàna a tha luma làn ceòl gus am faigh an dithis aca òran sònraichte ionnsachadh 's an guthan seinn a' lo. Oona can't sleep for worrying about participating in the dawn chorus for the first time. Mama takes her on a late-night adventure filled with music so that they can learn a special new song together and find their best singing voices.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha an t-acras uabhasach air Baba 's tha bhrù aige rùchdail! Ge-tà, chan eil sgeul air Oona son a thoirt dhachaigh gu bhiadh... an tig aig a bhuthaid bheag dàna a shlighe fhèin a dhèanamh air ais chun an fhaiche? Baba is a hungry puffling and his tummy is very rumbly! However, Oona has gone out to play and isn't around to take him home for dinner. Will the adventurous Baba be able to make his own way back to the puffin burrow?

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: An deis meadhan geama, tha an dèideag aig Sula a’ dol an sàs ann an craobh. Gus cobhair a dhèanamh oirre, tha Bing a cur Hoppa-tì suas às a dèidh ach ‘s ann a tha Hoppa-tì an uairsin glacte sna geugan cuideachd! In the middle of a game, Sula’s toy hippo ends up stuck in a tree! Keen to help, Bing sends Hoppity up to rescue her but unfortunately, Hoppity also ends up caught among the branches!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing ‘S Pando a’ cluich a-muigh san fhuachd ‘s tha Flop air teòclaid theth a dhèanamh dhaibh gus an cumail blàth. Ge-tà, tha Bing a’ cur a chorragan am broinn a chupa anns a bheil an stuth goileach! Bing and Pando are playing outside, where it’s so cold they can see their breath, but Flop makes hot chocolate to warm them up. However, an impatient Bing sticks his fingers into the cup of very hot liquid!

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha sgoilear ùr sa chlas, Anna a th’ oirre. ‘S e nighean sàmhach, dìomhair a th’ innte, cha bhi i bruidhinn is chan eil ùidh aice cluich còmhla ri na sgoilearan eile. Gu h-obann, tha Anna a’ dol à sealladh. Dè tha cho dìomhair mu deidhinn? There's a new girl in school, Anna. She's an enigmatic girl that doesn't talk and or seem interested in the other kids. Suddenly Anna disappears. What's the mystery hidden behind Anna?

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha e an urra ri na Pluic Fèis Bhliadhnail na Coimhearsnachd a chur air dòigh am bliadhna, ach tha na nàbaidhean farmadach aca, na h-Àrdain, a’ feuchainn ris a’ ghnothach a mhilleadh orra. It is the Spuds’ turn to run Grim Fest, the annual festival at Grimsby Heights, but their jealous neighbours, The Dups, are out to sabotage their efforts.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl sgìth de riaghailtean a mhàthar agus athar. Tha e a’ fuireach san amar ùine airson cabhag a chur air an aois, is tha seo ga thionndadh na bhodach rocach. A-nis ’s urrainn dha fhèin na riaghailtean a chruthachadh. Dave is tired of following his mum and dad’s rules. Creating a reverse fountain of youth in the bathtub, he shrivels himself into an old man and sets about making up rules of his own.

programme.title: Buidheagain
programme.desc: Short Gaelic film for the younger audience. A traveller girl, devoted to her brood of laying hens, seeks revenge on a mean farmer.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha Mgr Mackle fo uallach agus chan eil e a’ faighinn fois an àite sam bith. Tha Ms Dallas air a dòigh glan gu bheil An Còirneal Cliseam a' tadhal air an sgoil airson clas air leth a theagaisg. Mr Mackle is under pressure and he can't seem to get any respite. Ms Dallas is delighted that Colonel Clisham is visiting the school to teach a camouflage class.

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo tha i a’ dèanamh soidhne agus rudan eile a-mach à sreang airson an stiùidio aice a sgeadachadh. Choirstaidh is back with another programme from her studio A’ Chùil. She makes a sign, and other things, out of string to decorate her studio.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach seachdainn le sgioba-naidheachd BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Prògram spioradail le laoidhean, sailm agus leughaidhean bho Coats ann am Pàislig, air a lìbhrigeadh le Iain MacFhionghain. Am measg na seinneadairean bidh Maeve NicFhionghain, Ruairidh Gray agus Iain ‘Costello’ MacÌomhair. Cuideachd, an còisir Binneas fo stiùir John Joe MacNèill. Bidh Iain Eàrdsaidh Mac a’ Mhaoilein a’ meòrachadh air cuspair creideimh le leughadh agus smuain, dàn is seallaidhean spioradail à Tiriodh ann an companachd Dòmhnall Eachann Meek agus seirm adhraidh air a’ phìob bho Chloe Steele à Manachainn nan Lios. Iain MacKinnon presents a mix of hymns, psalms and readings from Coats in Paisley. Amongst the singers performing are Maeve MacKinnon, Ruairidh Gray and Iain ‘Costello’ Maciver. Also appearing is the choir Binneas, conducted by John Joe MacNeil. John Archie MacMillan reflects on his beliefs with a selected reading and thought, spiritual poetry and landscapes in the company of Donald E Meek in Tiree. Chloe Steele performs a tune of worship on the pipes from Beauly Priory. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Eòrpa
programme.desc: Aithris le Darren Linc a chaidh a chraoladh lathaichean mus an do bhòt an Rìoghachd Aonaichte airson Brexit ann an 2016. Darren Laing’s 2016 report, first broadcast days before the United Kingdom’s vote to leave the European Union.

programme.title: Hebridean Baker - Nordic Islands
programme.desc: Coinneach MacLeod explores the food traditions of the Faroes. Tha Coinneach MacLeòid a’ faighinn blasad de chultar a’ bhidhe sna h-Eileanan Fàrach.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke head to the woods in search of birch sap, fungi and midgies!

programme.title: Valtos | Aig a’ Mhullach
programme.desc: Na DJs Gàidhealach, Valtos, le cuirm sgoinneil aig mullach a’ Chàirn Ghuirm. Seallaidhean àlainn is ceòl air leth. Thig cuide ri Martyn is Dan is iad a’ dèanamh ùrlar-dannsaidh à Stèisean Tàrmagain – am fear as àirde ann an Alba. Le taic bho Eilidh NicCarmaig, Lana Pheutan is Ruairidh Gray, agus criomagan bhon chuirm aca sna Barrowlands ann an Glaschu. Highland DJs Valtos stage a unique event at the top of Cairngorm Mountain, featuring beautiful scenery and incredible music. Join Martyn and Dan as they transform the iconic Ptarmigan Station into the highest dance floor in Scotland. Featuring contributions from musical collaborators Eilidh Cormack, Lana Pheutan and Ruairidh Gray, with highlights from their sell-out show at the Glasgow Barrowlands.

programme.title: Coin Trusaidh/Muster Dogs
programme.desc: Air an t-slighe bheòthail seo, tha sinn a’ faighinn sealladh nas dlùithe air beatha còig luchd-trèanaidh bho air feadh Astràilia agus iad uile a’ gabhail pàirt san deuchainn againn: cuilean Kelpie a thoirt gu ìre – airson a bhith mar phàirt de sgioba nan con trusaidh. Chan eil e a’ toirt fad sam bith dhan na cuileanan àlainn seo iad fhèin a bhlàthachadh ris an luchd-seilbh ùra aca agus tha an trèanadh aca a’ tòiseachadh gu luath. Tha ainmean air a thoirt dhaibh; le Annie, Gossip, Lucifer, Spice agus Chet a’ faighinn trèanadh air thoiseach air a’ chiad dùbhlan aca, a’ meas na sgilean aca aig aois ceithir mìosan. An action-packed yet intimate character journey about the lives of five very different Australian dog trainers as they participate in our experiment: to take a new Kelpie pup and transform it from a greenhorn to an efficient working member of the mustering pack. These cute new puppies instantly wriggle their way into the hearts of our new owners and training begins quickly. Names are given and Annie, Gossip, Lucifer, Spice and Chet embark on the challenge of training for the first assessment of their skills at four months. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: The story of life, from the first primitive cells to the plants and animals that now live around us. David Attenborough examines the uses and advantages of birds' unique possession - the feather. Man has yet to invent anything that, weight for weight, is as strong as the feather. Feathers are insulators, they provide the surface of the most perfect aerofoils known - bird's wings. Plus they play a central role in courtship.

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: More than 150 of the country's best young musicians take us on a metaphorical musical journey to the underworld and back under the watchful eye of conductor and composer Thomas Adès. Always a hotly anticipated highlight of any BBC Proms season, the National Youth Orchestra is at the Royal Albert Hall with a programme that opens with Liszt's intoxicating Mephisto Waltz No 1, a whirlwind score following the Faust legend as he waltzes out into the forest with a local village girl. Next up is a rare treat of a new piece conducted by the composer himself: Purgatorio–Dante ballet Part II is Thomas Adès’s contemplation of purgatory in this central act of his Grammy Award-winning ballet. To round off the concert, the orchestra delivers the dazzling Symphonie Fantastique by Berlioz. A vast young orchestra drenches the Royal Albert Hall in this mesmerising symphony. Presented by Petroc Trelawny.

programme.title: The Brontës Lived Here: Writers' Houses
programme.desc: Margaret Drabble visits Haworth Parsonage and the Yorkshire Moors, home of the famous literary family the Brontës and the setting for Emily's Wuthering Heights.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: It was at a 1975 production of his play The Birthday Party that Harold Pinter first met Lady Antonia Fraser and changed both their lives with the single phrase: 'Must you go?' What followed was a scandal that gripped London's high society and a marriage that lasted 28 years, until Pinter's death in 2008. Here, Lady Antonia explains how that original encounter has always meant that the play holds a special meaning for her, despite its unsettling nature - and she looks back fondly on the BBC's 1987 acclaimed adaptation of The Birthday Party and her husband's performance as the mysteriously menacing Goldberg, alongside a cast that includes Kenneth Cranham, Julie Walters and Dame Joan Plowright.

programme.title: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: It's Stanley's birthday, but the party that is thrown for him is not quite what he was expecting. Written by Harold Pinter.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: Nigel Williams's two-part film biography explores Pinter's life, work, and political passions - from his East End childhood to his work as an actor, his experience of both early critical rejection and adulation, his screenwriting, and his love of poetry and passion for cricket. Part One explores Pinter's key theme - the room - through the very rooms in which he wrote his first great series of plays. Arena reveals the links between the plays and places, and meets the people who live there now. We visit the East London terraced house room where Pinter grew up and first wrote poetry; the theatre dressing room where he began to formulate his ideas about playwriting and language; the sitting room in the London cold-water flat where he wrote his first hit, The Caretaker, and his study in the bow-fronted house in Worthing, where he lived in the sixties with his first wife Vivien Merchant, and wrote The Homecoming. Harold Pinter has given Arena exclusive access to personal recordings in which he talks frankly to his biographer Michael Billington. Presented for the first time on television, they tell Pinter's story in his own words, as he remembers it.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: In part two of this film biography, Arena explores the relationship between the public and private dimensions of the famous playwright and actor's life and work; the intimacy of his plays since the seventies; his work in films and television drama; his passion for poetry; and his fervent 'political engagement'. Arena accompanied Pinter for two years to film plays and events in America and all over Europe. The wildly funny Celebration features a group of friends celebrating in a restaurant and, over the course of the evening, revealing details of their private lives in this very public space. Arena reunites members of the cast, including Lindsay Duncan, Andy de la Tour, Susan Wooldridge and Indira Varma, who discuss their working relationship with Harold Pinter. Other contributors include his wife Lady Antonia Fraser, journalist John Pilger and Pinter's biographer Michael Billington.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Can oil really save Venezuela's economy? The country has the world's largest reserves, so can it take advantage whilst global energy supplies are under pressure because of events in the Middle East? Reviving Venezuela's biggest industry is just one part of the change that's needed as the country recovers from deadly earthquakes and tries to restructure a mountain of debt after years of mismanagement. Respected former central bank president Ruth Krivoy and leading oil executive Ali Moshiri of Amos Global Energy give their takes on the role oil can play. Meanwhile, the president of Venezuela's Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Felipe Capozzolo of Fedecamaras, explains some of the other reforms that could help the country become wealthy again.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: The Big Cases
programme.desc: The chilling story of Hull’s funeral home horror. How an undertaker drowning in debt betrayed hundreds of grieving families. Robert Bush hoarded bodies, sold fake funeral plans and presented families with the ashes of strangers. His shocking crimes went undetected for years. The discovery led to one of the most complex investigations in Humberside Police’s history, with help from the National Crime Agency. At the heart of this are grieving families. In their darkest days, they fought for laws to regulate the funeral industry so that others never suffer their pain - or guilt - again.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded explores how artificial intelligence is reshaping the future of work and asks whether jobs will disappear or be redesigned around powerful new technologies. We hear from leading experts on what this shift means for today's workforce and for young people preparing for life after university, as everyone adapts to stay relevant in a digital age.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: Nawal al Maghafi journeys across Iran to areas rarely accessed by international journalists, speaking to Iranians across the political and social divide about the impact of the war, and what comes next. Also, BBC Eye meets the motorcycle riders who risk their lives to smuggle Iranian fuel across the mountains into Pakistan. The BBC's senior international correspondent Nawal Al Maghafi is reporting from Iran on condition that none of her material is used on the BBC's Persian Service. These restrictions apply to all international media organisations operating in Iran.

programme.title: Prayer and Reflection
programme.desc: We join the faithful gathered at St Patrick’s Roman Catholic Cathedral, Armagh, for a special evening prayer service to mark the 50th anniversary of the canonisation of Saint Oliver Plunkett. The service is led by Archbishop Eamon Martin, archbishop of Armagh and primate of all Ireland. Armagh holds a deep spiritual connection to Saint Oliver Plunkett, who served as archbishop there in the 17th century. The cathedral, standing on its historic hill, provides a fitting setting for this moment of remembrance and thanksgiving. Scripture readings will be complemented by hymns and choral music sung by choirs. Prayers will be offered in the spirit of Saint Oliver’s enduring legacy.

programme.title: Celebrity Escape to the Country
programme.desc: After decades of touring and performing, ‘The One and Only’ singer, musician and actor Chesney Hawkes is looking for a rural hideaway to escape the bright lights and big stages. Jules Hudson has a selection of chart-topping character homes and is optimistic that the Cotswolds countryside will be a smash hit for rock star Chesney and his wife Krissy, along with their three grown-up children. On the billing are exquisite interiors, cottage charm and property perfection, but can Jules persuade Chesney to swap leather for tweed at the manorial mystery house?

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Adam Henson is in West Sussex with 26-year-old soft fruit grower Archie Evans, who took over the family business determined to put his own stamp on it. As they bring in the harvest, Archie explains why he scaled back production, moved away from supplying major supermarkets and began selling directly to customers. With the family’s finances at stake, will his gamble secure the farm’s future? Adam also delves into the Countryfile archives to revisit some of the inspirational farmers we have met across the UK.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team visit Clissold Park in the London borough of Hackney, where treasures include some rather pricey whisky bottles and a silver ‘parrot’ ring by Mocheh Oved that brings back memories for John Benjamin. Lisa Lloyd examines a glamorous portrait of a young Helen Mirren, and Marc Allum is thrilled to see a collection of vintage skateboards. Serhat Ahmet takes a closer look at a miniature porcelain set of heraldic figures known as the Queen’s beasts, while an original Clint Eastwood film poster proves to be a lucky find. Ronnie Archer-Morgan is transported back to his former career as a hairdresser when he sees a pair of handmade hot combs for styling African-Caribbean hair, and Lars Tharp is intrigued by a ceramic jar that once housed a doctor’s supply of leeches.

programme.title: The Rapture
programme.desc: CCTV raises doubts over Bethany’s honesty. Gabs turns to the Climate Front for help. A new drawing from Bethany leads Gabs and Dick to the old ruins, where the truth is revealed.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: The barrier to growing your own fruit and vegetables is often simply a lack of space. programme.desc: Sitcom featuring Jack and Victor, two irrepressible pensioners first seen in the comedy series Chewin' the Fat, along with their dependable pals Winston and Tam, fresh out of Craiglang and taking on the world. programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: The Scottish Police Force are used to expecting the unexpected and every day contains the familiar element of surprise. This spoof 'blue light' documentary tails the Scot Squad as they check out what's inside a smoking van, unearth some potentially explosive evidence and learn how to go to the toilet with two broken arms. Newly promoted actual PC Ken Beattie now finds himself called upon to provide a character reference. Knights of the road Singh and McKirdy gallantly help out a hen do, and the Chief attempts international diplomacy by shouting loudly at a laptop.

Meanwhile, David and Alexis hit Mutt’s barn party, where David and Stevie compete for the same guy, and Alexis finally comes to terms with the end of her relationship with Mutt.

programme.title: Bluestone 42
programme.desc: The team suffer a Taliban attack on base, which distracts Ellen and Bird from their bickering and Towerblock from a difficult phone call to his wife.

programme.title: Bluestone 42
programme.desc: Ellen has to learn to bend the rules, Mac and Rocket do gladiatorial combat and Bird sets Simon up for a fall.

programme.title: Bluestone 42
programme.desc: As the team prepare to leave Afghanistan for good, Simon receives some devastating news.

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc: Twenty-one-year-old Newcastle lass Kelsie loves nothing more than showing off her acrobatic party tricks, vlogging dates live to her friends and having a cheeky cocktail or three on a first date. Her wild antics are keeping the lads away, and Kelsie’s chances of getting a second date are nil! Best mate Tegan thinks Kelsie is hopeless when it comes to dating. Fed up with giving advice that falls on deaf ears, Tegan has enlisted the help of sex and relationship expert Oloni for a much-needed intervention. Oloni gives Kelsie a cold dose of reality as she asks friends, family and exes to dish the dirt via video feedback to show Kelsie where it’s all going wrong. With a string of dating fails under Kelsie’s belt, Oloni sends her on three challenge dates and watches on with Tegan as Kelsie tries to practise some first date dos and don’ts, but can Kelsie resist doing the crab when one of her dates turns out to be an acrobat?

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc: Khalil never remembers his dates’ names, so he calls them all 'baby girl' to skirt around it. Obsessed with looking good, he checks himself out in the reflection of a spoon every 20 minutes on dinner dates and thinks it’s impressive to tell boastful, drunken stories. No wonder the ladies don’t come back for a second date! Cavan is fed up of his best mate Khalil’s dating fails and Khalil not listening to his advice, so he calls on the help of Gen Z's most trusted sex and relationships expert, Oloni, to put this 21-year-old Notts boy on the spot and get him to own up to his bad dating habits. Khalil and Oloni watch video feedback from some very honest friends and exes to show him first hand where it's all going wrong, before Oloni sets Khalil up on a series of first dates that will challenge him to turn him from a bad date to a good date. Under the watchful eye of Oloni and Cavan, can Khalil stop calling his dates 'baby girl', can he resist the urge to check himself out and will he take Oloni's advice on board and stop telling laddish, drunken stories?

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: Deb invites new boyfriend Dev home to meet her daughters Billie and Josie whilst desperately trying to suppress how troubled they are. Josie’s face isn’t doing a very good job of covering up how depressed she is, so Deb sets out to teach her how fulfilling capitalism can be by taking her shopping. Billie spots the love of her life, Nicky, with a new girl, so decides to win him back with a significant change to her appearance and discovers just how much love hurts.

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: Despite enjoying his stoic silence, Deb’s starting to worry that she and Dev might have nothing to talk about. She’s determined to find something in common through any means necessary. Billie is worried that Nicky might be pulling away from her so decides to play hard to get. Josie is trying to impress the girl at the bar, but her relentlessly loving and wormy boyfriend Seb has just found out she’s back and is keen to get things back to how they used to be.

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: The pressure is on for Josie - she is determined to make her birthday dinner last as long as possible so she doesn’t have to come good on a deal made with boyfriend Seb. Deb thinks she’s really getting through to Dev’s wallet, and maybe this time he’s going to step up and finally pay for something - especially considering he’s the one who suggested they all go for dinner.

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: As Billie and Josie’s imminent breakdowns loom, Deb tries to pretend everything’s fine with a big trip to the woods... but she’s mainly there to prove she’s just as outdoorsy as Dev’s wife used to be. In an attempt to prove she’s more than her trauma and because she’s got 'loads' of pain, Josie decides she’s an artist, which upsets everyone. She doesn’t let her lack of inspiration or discernible talent stop her. Billie welcomes a new man into her life, and takes on the big questions, like if God is good, why is there evil in the world? And if God made nature, why is it so relentlessly boring?

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: Over one long night, Deb, Billie and Josie find their own ways to process death after visiting their nan in hospital. Josie starts to wonder whether her own pathetic life might be half-lived, and Billie tries to find their dad. Billie and Josie attempt to cope with their profound existential despair by going clubbing, where Billie befriends her rival, and Josie finally works out who she is. Back at home, Dev’s got a bee in his bonnet about sending the girls to therapy, and Deb is on a mission to prove therapy is useless. Seb starts to panic that Josie might be kissing a girl.

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: Preparing to see their dad again, Josie writes a speech to tell him how she feels, and Billie’s got newfound confidence that all men eventually come crawling back. Dev is gutted he’s not invited to a family funeral and has a very big question for Deb. With a fresh swagger, Josie’s breakdown is welcome news for Seb, who can’t wait to spend the rest of his life with her. Lunch at Dev’s house goes to waste as it’s abandoned for a rescue mission, and, worst of all, Deb might be forced to come clean about her lie.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: The A to Z of TV Gardening
programme.desc: Carol Kirkwood takes an alphabetical journey through the world of gardening, getting inspiration and advice from some of the BBC's most popular garden presenters and programmes. In this episode, she's exploring subjects that all begin with the letter R. Programmes include Gardeners' World, Flying Gardener, RHS Chelsea Flower Show and Countryfile. With presenters Toby Buckland, Rachel de Thame, Monty Don, Julia Bradbury, Chris Beardshaw, Alan Titchmarsh and Joe Swift.

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Christine Walkden's balloon travels over the flattest part of Britain as she descends on Norfolk. At East Ruston Gardens she helps cut a hole in a hedge and meets Kathryn, a very determined woman. At the Bressingham Gardens, Christine assists in preparing a tree for felling and we discover the fascinating human history of the Norfolk Broads.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: In the first of four special episodes, Adam Henson meets a new generation of farmers navigating the challenges and opportunities of producing our food. Along the way, Adam gets a glimpse into their daily lives, exploring how they are facing the growing uncertainty in the industry and seeing what innovations they have embraced to secure the future of their farms. Travelling to Bala in Gwynedd, north Wales, he meets 23-year-old sheep and cattle farmer Erin McNaught. A fourth-generation farmer, Erin manages around 250 acres across three sites in partnership with her grandfather. Adam joins her on the daily rounds to discover the realities of running a traditional hill farm and hears how she is balancing the responsibility of carrying on a family legacy with the need to build a resilient business for the future. Adam also looks back through the show's archives at some of the inspirational young farmers we have met across the UK.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek explores three well-known castles as he revisits his favourite heritage walks. They include Powys Castle, the spooky Margam Castle and the medieval Kidwelly Castle.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Brian Cunningham’s beginner’s guide to vegetable growing started in April, and now it’s time to reap the rewards as he starts to harvest from the veg plot at Beechgrove Garden. Calum Clunie sows for winter crops as he starts the sowing cycle again on his family-sized plo. He also refreshes the containers he started in April as a demonstration of just what you can do if space is limited and you only room for some pots. Brian and Calum tackle Beechgrove’s hedges after checking carefully for bird nest activity, and Brian advises on caring for common houseplants. There is a visit to St Andrews Botanic Garden, along with the week’s handy hints.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Rosie Birkett celebrates the best of summer salads with her bavette carpaccio, fried capers and a tangy mustard dressing, all served alongside a refreshing panzanella. Mike Reid kicks off the BBQ vibes indoors with his mango-marinated spatchcock chicken, fiery kiwi hot sauce and a bitter radicchio and pear salad. The former head chef at the Italian embassy, Danilo Cortellini, serves up a multicoloured ricotta-stuffed ravioli dressed in basil and tomato sauce. Jez Rose heads to a very soggy Leicestershire to get picking, prepping and packing a classic elderflower cordial. Genevieve Taylor continues the barbecue theme by demonstrating how to master fish on the grill with leek-wrapped cod and almond saffron sauce. And finally, Oti Mabuse faces her food heaven or food hell. Meanwhile, Rick Stein rustles up a classic Italian dish in his Cornish kitchen, and Si and Dave make their way towards a fusion feast in Newport.

programme.title: Indian Food Made Easy
programme.desc: Anjum Anand heads off to Cornwall to meet self-taught chefs Nirmal and Louis who run the The Little Cornish Curry Company. Originally from Birmingham, for the last few years they have been serving up curry at the farmers markets near where they live as well as catering for the odd event. But now they are about to face a new test. Local pub The Galleon Inn is launching a curry night with Louis and Nirmal doing the food. They have decided that the best way to convert the customers to Indian food is to start with a regional favourite - fish. However Louis and Nirmal haven't used fish in Indian food much, so first up Anjum takes them to famous Looe fish market where the fish is officially the freshest in Britain. Having chosen some fantastic Pollock, Anjum shows them how to make a rich, flavoursome South Indian coconut fish curry with a side order of yellow lemon rice and crab cakes garnished with tangy tamarind mayonnaise.

programme.title: Indian Food Made Easy
programme.desc: Anjum Anand sees how well all the people in the previous episodes have got on with their new found cooking skills by holding a party in her garden. The catch - they all have to make an Indian dish for the others to try. First of all Anjum must prepare her contribution - a glorious spiced roast leg of lamb, commonly known in India as a raan. To get the best meat available she visits a top Halal butchers in South London, and gets to know her goat from her lamb. Then she starts to re-visit her Indian food novices: good friend Alex is going to cook a classic side dish of paneer with spinach; glamorous Panthea is going to try her hand at a creamy raita; head chef Elisha from the health spa is going to whip up a fabulous mushroom pilaff, and Paul the firefighter is going to try and get to grips with peshwari naan. With the sun finally coming out, and cocktail expert Ben Reed getting the party-goers in the mood, it is time for Anjum and the guests to see how they've all got on.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: Dr and Mrs McKenna's holiday in North Africa is interrupted when a passing acquaintance dies and they learn their son has been kidnapped.

programme.title: Cricket: The Hundred
programme.desc: Coverage of The Hundred 100-ball cricket tournament in the women's game.

programme.title: Cricket: The Hundred
programme.desc: Coverage of The Hundred 100-ball cricket tournament in the men's game.

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: The magnificent Lou Sanders introduces comedians Celya AB and Neil Delamere to the stage.

programme.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
programme.desc: A week in the life of Llewyn Davis, a struggling folk singer in 1961 New York. Penniless, homeless and sleeping on the couches of friends, he is hoping for his big break in the music industry.

programme.title: Lady Macbeth
programme.desc: Newly married to a rich industrialist, Katherine finds herself confined to the house and starved of companionship. Forced to spend her days in endless tedium when her husband is called away to one of his collieries, she begins a passionate and fiery relationship with a young groom from the estate, beginning a conflict with her stern and unforgiving family that will end in tragedy.

programme.desc: Brian Cunningham’s beginner’s guide to vegetable growing started in April, and now it’s time to reap the rewards as he starts to harvest from the veg plot at Beechgrove Garden. Calum Clunie sows for winter crops as he starts the sowing cycle again on his family-sized plo. He also refreshes the containers he started in April as a demonstration of just what you can do if space is limited and you only room for some pots. Brian and Calum tackle Beechgrove’s hedges after checking carefully for bird nest activity, and Brian advises on caring for common houseplants. There is a visit to St Andrews Botanic Garden, along with the week’s handy hints.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Rosie Birkett celebrates the best of summer salads with her bavette carpaccio, fried capers and a tangy mustard dressing, all served alongside a refreshing panzanella. Mike Reid kicks off the BBQ vibes indoors with his mango-marinated spatchcock chicken, fiery kiwi hot sauce and a bitter radicchio and pear salad. The former head chef at the Italian embassy, Danilo Cortellini, serves up a multicoloured ricotta-stuffed ravioli dressed in basil and tomato sauce. Jez Rose heads to a very soggy Leicestershire to get picking, prepping and packing a classic elderflower cordial. Genevieve Taylor continues the barbecue theme by demonstrating how to master fish on the grill with leek-wrapped cod and almond saffron sauce. And finally, Oti Mabuse faces her food heaven or food hell. Meanwhile, Rick Stein rustles up a classic Italian dish in his Cornish kitchen, and Si and Dave make their way towards a fusion feast in Newport.

programme.title: Indian Food Made Easy
programme.desc: Anjum Anand heads off to Cornwall to meet self-taught chefs Nirmal and Louis who run the The Little Cornish Curry Company. Originally from Birmingham, for the last few years they have been serving up curry at the farmers markets near where they live as well as catering for the odd event. But now they are about to face a new test. Local pub The Galleon Inn is launching a curry night with Louis and Nirmal doing the food. They have decided that the best way to convert the customers to Indian food is to start with a regional favourite - fish. However Louis and Nirmal haven't used fish in Indian food much, so first up Anjum takes them to famous Looe fish market where the fish is officially the freshest in Britain. Having chosen some fantastic Pollock, Anjum shows them how to make a rich, flavoursome South Indian coconut fish curry with a side order of yellow lemon rice and crab cakes garnished with tangy tamarind mayonnaise.

programme.title: Indian Food Made Easy
programme.desc: Anjum Anand sees how well all the people in the previous episodes have got on with their new found cooking skills by holding a party in her garden. The catch - they all have to make an Indian dish for the others to try. First of all Anjum must prepare her contribution - a glorious spiced roast leg of lamb, commonly known in India as a raan. To get the best meat available she visits a top Halal butchers in South London, and gets to know her goat from her lamb. Then she starts to re-visit her Indian food novices: good friend Alex is going to cook a classic side dish of paneer with spinach; glamorous Panthea is going to try her hand at a creamy raita; head chef Elisha from the health spa is going to whip up a fabulous mushroom pilaff, and Paul the firefighter is going to try and get to grips with peshwari naan. With the sun finally coming out, and cocktail expert Ben Reed getting the party-goers in the mood, it is time for Anjum and the guests to see how they've all got on.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: In the first of four special episodes, Adam Henson meets a new generation of farmers navigating the challenges and opportunities of producing our food. Along the way, Adam gets a glimpse into their daily lives, exploring how they are facing the growing uncertainty in the industry and seeing what innovations they have embraced to secure the future of their farms. Travelling to Bala in Gwynedd, north Wales, he meets 23-year-old sheep and cattle farmer Erin McNaught. A fourth-generation farmer, Erin manages around 250 acres across three sites in partnership with her grandfather. Adam joins her on the daily rounds to discover the realities of running a traditional hill farm and hears how she is balancing the responsibility of carrying on a family legacy with the need to build a resilient business for the future. Adam also looks back through the show's archives at some of the inspirational young farmers we have met across the UK.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: The team are in for a busy day at The Grove Vets, and Fern Britton is there to see how their furry patients get on. First through the doors is a special patient: vets Andy and Amy's own cat, Frank, who needs some dental attention. Rhodesian Ridgeback Cleo has been suffering with skin irritation, and Shih Tzu cross Lacey has an operation to remove some mammary tumours. Fern gets hands-on in Winter the kitten's castration, and cavapoo puppy Connie comes in to be spayed. James talks Fern through some healthy dog treat options, and takes a trip to a Somerset rescue centre that rehabilitates and rehomes neglected horses.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Puglia meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck in producing a staple of Italian cuisine passata before discovering the history of pomegranates in this region. In an area known as 'The Tabletop' he learns how farmers work day-in day-out to produce tomatoes for passata before heading back to farmer Mario's house to help the family make their own version that will see them through the year. Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you: indulgent, delicious meatball and mozzarella ciabatta rolls. His journey then takes him South to discover an ingredient you might not associate with Italy but one that has a long heritage: pomegranates. He joins Dario as harvest begins to learn the special connection between this region and produce. After a hard day's work Tom cooks lamb cutlets with pomegranate couscous to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Paris to take on The Vixen and The Beast, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with a quiz on an open top bus around the Arc de Triomphe. The race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving waxworks, snails, Notre Dame, and a captive music quiz in the back of a taxi!

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Our coasts have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but the challenges of parenthood are exacerbated with warming seas - forming earlier than ever before, a hurricane catches a flamingo colony while their chicks are still on the nest. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Van Der Valk and the team are called in when an environmental campaigner is murdered on the eve of a global conference. Several potential suspects are caught on CCTV, one of which would appear to be Cobie Stegenga, a famous singer who went missing and is now presumed dead. The world assumes she committed suicide as a result of the stress of fame. Eddie Suleman, a former fan of hers, thinks differently. Her body was never found and he thinks she just went into hiding. Either way, she is now the prime suspect in a murder investigation. How do you find a missing person? Van Der Valk connects with Cobie's father, a man who has never given up hope that his daughter was alive, in order to find out the truth.

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.desc: Joining Alan this time are actress Sarah Parish and broadcaster John Humphreys as Manor Farm holds its first-ever Mounted Games with young riders from the Royal Windsor Horse Show, horticulturalist David Domoney showcases the very best in garden pollinators, and the team look at why British rose wine has never been more popular.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: The team are in for a busy day at The Grove Vets, and Fern Britton is there to see how their furry patients get on. First through the doors is a special patient: vets Andy and Amy's own cat, Frank, who needs some dental attention. Rhodesian Ridgeback Cleo has been suffering with skin irritation, and Shih Tzu cross Lacey has an operation to remove some mammary tumours. Fern gets hands-on in Winter the kitten's castration, and cavapoo puppy Connie comes in to be spayed. James talks Fern through some healthy dog treat options, and takes a trip to a Somerset rescue centre that rehabilitates and rehomes neglected horses.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Puglia meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck in producing a staple of Italian cuisine passata before discovering the history of pomegranates in this region. In an area known as 'The Tabletop' he learns how farmers work day-in day-out to produce tomatoes for passata before heading back to farmer Mario's house to help the family make their own version that will see them through the year. Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you: indulgent, delicious meatball and mozzarella ciabatta rolls. His journey then takes him South to discover an ingredient you might not associate with Italy but one that has a long heritage: pomegranates. He joins Dario as harvest begins to learn the special connection between this region and produce. After a hard day's work Tom cooks lamb cutlets with pomegranate couscous to celebrate.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: National and international news with reports and analysis from ITV's Correspondents in the UK and around the world. [S]

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: The Spy Who Loved Me
programme.desc: When nuclear weapons vanish, Bond uncovers a sinister plotDanger lurks

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Paris to take on The Vixen and The Beast, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with a quiz on an open top bus around the Arc de Triomphe. The race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving waxworks, snails, Notre Dame, and a captive music quiz in the back of a taxi!

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Our coasts have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but the challenges of parenthood are exacerbated with warming seas - forming earlier than ever before, a hurricane catches a flamingo colony while their chicks are still on the nest. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

programme.title: Coronation Street

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Van Der Valk and the team are called in when an environmental campaigner is murdered on the eve of a global conference. Several potential suspects are caught on CCTV, one of which would appear to be Cobie Stegenga, a famous singer who went missing and is now presumed dead. The world assumes she committed suicide as a result of the stress of fame. Eddie Suleman, a former fan of hers, thinks differently. Her body was never found and he thinks she just went into hiding. Either way, she is now the prime suspect in a murder investigation. How do you find a missing person? Van Der Valk connects with Cobie's father, a man who has never given up hope that his daughter was alive, in order to find out the truth.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: National and international news with reports and analysis from ITV's Correspondents in the UK and around the world. [S]

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Inside The Langham: Britain’s First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The Langham’s CEO arrives in London from its head office in Hong Kong to inspect one of the hotel’s most ambitious renovations yet, a vast new terrace added to one of its most exclusive suites, and head bartender Giulia teams up with The Langham’s executive chef Berwyn to spice up the menu in the world-famous Artesian bar that was once named Best Bar in the World - however, a clash in taste means that not all of the pair's choices will make the grade.

The teams land in Paris to take on The Vixen and The Beast, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with a quiz on an open top bus around the Arc de Triomphe. The race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving waxworks, snails, Notre Dame, and a captive music quiz in the back of a taxi!

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Our coasts have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but the challenges of parenthood are exacerbated with warming seas - forming earlier than ever before, a hurricane catches a flamingo colony while their chicks are still on the nest. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Van Der Valk and the team are called in when an environmental campaigner is murdered on the eve of a global conference. Several potential suspects are caught on CCTV, one of which would appear to be Cobie Stegenga, a famous singer who went missing and is now presumed dead. The world assumes she committed suicide as a result of the stress of fame. Eddie Suleman, a former fan of hers, thinks differently. Her body was never found and he thinks she just went into hiding. Either way, she is now the prime suspect in a murder investigation. How do you find a missing person? Van Der Valk connects with Cobie's father, a man who has never given up hope that his daughter was alive, in order to find out the truth.

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: The team are in for a busy day at The Grove Vets, and Fern Britton is there to see how their furry patients get on. First through the doors is a special patient: vets Andy and Amy's own cat, Frank, who needs some dental attention. Rhodesian Ridgeback Cleo has been suffering with skin irritation, and Shih Tzu cross Lacey has an operation to remove some mammary tumours. Fern gets hands-on in Winter the kitten's castration, and cavapoo puppy Connie comes in to be spayed. James talks Fern through some healthy dog treat options, and takes a trip to a Somerset rescue centre that rehabilitates and rehomes neglected horses.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Puglia meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck in producing a staple of Italian cuisine passata before discovering the history of pomegranates in this region. In an area known as 'The Tabletop' he learns how farmers work day-in day-out to produce tomatoes for passata before heading back to farmer Mario's house to help the family make their own version that will see them through the year. Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you: indulgent, delicious meatball and mozzarella ciabatta rolls. His journey then takes him South to discover an ingredient you might not associate with Italy but one that has a long heritage: pomegranates. He joins Dario as harvest begins to learn the special connection between this region and produce. After a hard day's work Tom cooks lamb cutlets with pomegranate couscous to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Inside The Langham: Britain’s First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The Langham’s CEO arrives in London from its head office in Hong Kong to inspect one of the hotel’s most ambitious renovations yet, a vast new terrace added to one of its most exclusive suites, and head bartender Giulia teams up with The Langham’s executive chef Berwyn to spice up the menu in the world-famous Artesian bar that was once named Best Bar in the World - however, a clash in taste means that not all of the pair's choices will make the grade.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: The team are in for a busy day at The Grove Vets, and Fern Britton is there to see how their furry patients get on. First through the doors is a special patient: vets Andy and Amy's own cat, Frank, who needs some dental attention. Rhodesian Ridgeback Cleo has been suffering with skin irritation, and Shih Tzu cross Lacey has an operation to remove some mammary tumours. Fern gets hands-on in Winter the kitten's castration, and cavapoo puppy Connie comes in to be spayed. James talks Fern through some healthy dog treat options, and takes a trip to a Somerset rescue centre that rehabilitates and rehomes neglected horses.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Puglia meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck in producing a staple of Italian cuisine passata before discovering the history of pomegranates in this region. In an area known as 'The Tabletop' he learns how farmers work day-in day-out to produce tomatoes for passata before heading back to farmer Mario's house to help the family make their own version that will see them through the year. Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you: indulgent, delicious meatball and mozzarella ciabatta rolls. His journey then takes him South to discover an ingredient you might not associate with Italy but one that has a long heritage: pomegranates. He joins Dario as harvest begins to learn the special connection between this region and produce. After a hard day's work Tom cooks lamb cutlets with pomegranate couscous to celebrate.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: National and international news with reports and analysis from ITV's Correspondents in the UK and around the world. [S]

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: The Spy Who Loved Me
programme.desc: When nuclear weapons vanish, Bond uncovers a sinister plotDanger lurks

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Paris to take on The Vixen and The Beast, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with a quiz on an open top bus around the Arc de Triomphe. The race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving waxworks, snails, Notre Dame, and a captive music quiz in the back of a taxi!

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Our coasts have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but the challenges of parenthood are exacerbated with warming seas - forming earlier than ever before, a hurricane catches a flamingo colony while their chicks are still on the nest. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Van Der Valk and the team are called in when an environmental campaigner is murdered on the eve of a global conference. Several potential suspects are caught on CCTV, one of which would appear to be Cobie Stegenga, a famous singer who went missing and is now presumed dead. The world assumes she committed suicide as a result of the stress of fame. Eddie Suleman, a former fan of hers, thinks differently. Her body was never found and he thinks she just went into hiding. Either way, she is now the prime suspect in a murder investigation. How do you find a missing person? Van Der Valk connects with Cobie's father, a man who has never given up hope that his daughter was alive, in order to find out the truth.

James talks Fern through some healthy dog treat options, and takes a trip to a Somerset rescue centre that rehabilitates and rehomes neglected horses.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Puglia meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck in producing a staple of Italian cuisine passata before discovering the history of pomegranates in this region. In an area known as 'The Tabletop' he learns how farmers work day-in day-out to produce tomatoes for passata before heading back to farmer Mario's house to help the family make their own version that will see them through the year. Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you: indulgent, delicious meatball and mozzarella ciabatta rolls. His journey then takes him South to discover an ingredient you might not associate with Italy but one that has a long heritage: pomegranates. He joins Dario as harvest begins to learn the special connection between this region and produce. After a hard day's work Tom cooks lamb cutlets with pomegranate couscous to celebrate.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: National and international news with reports and analysis from ITV's Correspondents in the UK and around the world. [S,HD]

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: The Spy Who Loved Me
programme.desc: When nuclear weapons vanish, Bond uncovers a sinister plotDanger lurks

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Paris to take on The Vixen and The Beast, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with a quiz on an open top bus around the Arc de Triomphe. The race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving waxworks, snails, Notre Dame, and a captive music quiz in the back of a taxi!

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Our coasts have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but the challenges of parenthood are exacerbated with warming seas - forming earlier than ever before, a hurricane catches a flamingo colony while their chicks are still on the nest. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Van Der Valk and the team are called in when an environmental campaigner is murdered on the eve of a global conference. Several potential suspects are caught on CCTV, one of which would appear to be Cobie Stegenga, a famous singer who went missing and is now presumed dead. The world assumes she committed suicide as a result of the stress of fame. Eddie Suleman, a former fan of hers, thinks differently. Her body was never found and he thinks she just went into hiding. Either way, she is now the prime suspect in a murder investigation. How do you find a missing person? Van Der Valk connects with Cobie's father, a man who has never given up hope that his daughter was alive, in order to find out the truth.

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Puglia meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck in producing a staple of Italian cuisine passata before discovering the history of pomegranates in this region. In an area known as 'The Tabletop' he learns how farmers work day-in day-out to produce tomatoes for passata before heading back to farmer Mario's house to help the family make their own version that will see them through the year. Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you: indulgent, delicious meatball and mozzarella ciabatta rolls. His journey then takes him South to discover an ingredient you might not associate with Italy but one that has a long heritage: pomegranates. He joins Dario as harvest begins to learn the special connection between this region and produce. After a hard day's work Tom cooks lamb cutlets with pomegranate couscous to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Paris to take on The Vixen and The Beast, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with a quiz on an open top bus around the Arc de Triomphe. The race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving waxworks, snails, Notre Dame, and a captive music quiz in the back of a taxi!
